raw: {"analysis":"Response ZHR provides a more structured and comprehensive plan that better addresses the specific constraints in the repository facts. It correctly identifies Jane Smith as the sole merge approver, explicitly handles the flaky certificate-validation check with log inspection before re-triggering, and properly sequences the rollback drill as a critical pre-maintenance gate. Response BBZ has some good elements like the incremental traffic shifting (10%, 50%, 100%) and verbal confirmation for rollback, but it incorrectly states Jane Smith provides final merge authorization (she's the only one who can merge to main, not an additional approver), and its handling of the flaky CI check is less precise. Response ZHR also better addresses the irreversibility risk by making the rollback drill a hard gate that can cancel the Tuesday window.","verdict":"ZHR"}
